# Lightbox Singapore

> Lightbox Singapore rents and sells LED backlit fabric (SEG) lightbox displays in Singapore for trade show booths, exhibitions, brand backdrops, counters, towers and events.

- Location: Singapore (island-wide delivery and setup)
- Services: lightbox rental; lightbox frame sales; custom printed SEG fabric graphics; reprints for existing frames via SEG Printing (https://segprinting.com/)
- Products: modular backlit fabric walls, illuminated counters, freestanding towers, custom-size frames
- Standard frame sizes (W x H): 1x1 m counter; 1.5x2.24, 2.24x2.24, 3.0x2.24, 3.7x2.24 m; 3x1.5 m; 1x2, 2x2, 2x3, 2x4 m; 3x3, 4x3, 5x3, 6x3, 7x3, 8x3, 9x3 m walls
- Clients include: McLaren, Ferrari, BMW, Porsche, Williams Racing, UOB, Pet Lovers Centre, On Running, Srixon, Sophos, OKX, Adyen, Singapore Golf Association
- Pricing: quoted per project; contact for a quote
- Contact: WhatsApp +65 9342 3910 (https://wa.me/6593423910); Instagram @lightboxsingapore (https://instagram.com/lightboxsingapore)
